AK_EXUSIAI_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_AMMO.title: Ammo
AK_EXUSIAI_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_AMMO.descr: When you play an Attack, each hit spends 1 Ammo and deals 2 more damage. If you had more than 10 Ammo before playing it, every 5 additional Ammo increases this bonus by 1. Maximum 30 Ammo; reaching the maximum enters [gold]Overload[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_FIREPOWER_GENERIC.description: Firepower causes Ammo to deal additional damage.
